title: Abstract: The Art of Design
overview: Step inside the minds of the most innovative designers in a variety of disciplines and learn how design impacts every aspect of life.

title: Attack on London: Hunting the 7/7 Bombers
overview: Insider accounts and never-seen-before footage tell the story of the 7/7 bombings on London's transport network in 2005 — and its explosive aftermath.

title: Bobby Kennedy for President
overview: Historic footage and leading voices of the era examine the "Bobby Phenomenon" of the 1960s and the legacy of the man who helped redefine the country.

title: Cheer
overview: The stakes on the mat are high, but for these cheerleaders, the only thing more brutal than their workouts and more exceptional than their performances are the stories of adversity and triumph behind the athletes themselves.

title: Chef's Table: Legends
overview: The Emmy-nominated series celebrates four culinary giants — Jamie Oliver, José Andrés, Alice Waters and Thomas Keller — who changed how the world eats.

title: Escaping Twin Flames
overview: A couple built a spiritual business to help people find true love. Now, former followers are sharing their disturbing practices in this docuseries.

title: Five Came Back
overview: Five acclaimed contemporary directors tell the story of five legendary Hollywood filmmakers who enlisted in the armed forces to document World War II.

title: Flint Town
overview: Over a two-year period, filmmakers embedded with cops in Flint, Michigan, reveal a department grappling with volatile issues in untenable conditions.

title: High on the Hog: How African American Cuisine Transformed America
overview: Black food is American food. Chef and writer Stephen Satterfield traces the delicious, moving throughlines from Africa to Texas in this docuseries.

title: Hip Hop Evolution
overview: Hip-Hop today is a global culture that has changed music, dance, fashion, language —and even politics. But where did this worldwide cultural movement begin? We trace hip-hop back to its humble beginnings, when the kids of the Bronx crammed into house parties, rec rooms, and public parks to hear music like they’d never heard it before.

title: Immigration Nation
overview: With unprecedented access to ICE operations and moving portraits of immigrants, this documentary series takes a deep look at US immigration.

title: Jimmy Savile: A British Horror Story
overview: Jimmy Savile was one of the United Kingdom’s most beloved TV personalities. Shortly after his death in 2011, an investigation prompted more than 450 horrific allegations of sexual assault and abuse, with victims as young as 5.

title: Ladies First: A Story of Women in Hip-Hop
overview: Rappers, writers and experts detail the influence of women on hip-hop music and culture in this docuseries honoring the trailblazers and game-changers.

title: Lenox Hill
overview: From birth to brain surgery: This docuseries provides an intimate look at the lifesaving work of four doctors at Lenox Hill Hospital in NYC.

title: Living Undocumented
overview: Eight undocumented families' fates roller-coast as the United States' immigration policies are transformed.

title: My Love: Six Stories of True Love
overview: Inspired by the acclaimed Korean documentary My Love, Don't Cross That River, the poignant series MY LOVE documents a year in the lives of six elderly couples from around the world. Globe-trotting through Brazil, India, Japan, Korea, the U.S., and Spain, the six-part docuseries gets to the heart of long-lasting love.

title: November 13: Attack on Paris
overview: Survivors and first responders share personal stories of anguish, kindness and bravery that unfolded amid the Paris terror attacks of Nov. 13, 2015.

title: Pretend It's a City
overview: Wander the New York City streets and fascinating mind of wry writer, humorist and raconteur Fran Lebowitz as she sits down with Martin Scorsese.

title: Simone Biles Rising
overview: Follow gymnast Simone Biles as she balances her personal life, mental health journey and training ahead of a highly anticipated return to the Olympics Games of Paris 2024.

title: Surviving Black Hawk Down
overview: In extraordinary detail, US soldiers and Somali fighters recall the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu and the now-famous downing of three Black Hawk helicopters.

title: The Andy Warhol Diaries
overview: After he's shot in 1968, Andy Warhol begins documenting his life and feelings. Those diaries, and this series, reveal the secrets behind his persona.

title: The Confession Tapes
overview: This true crime documentary series investigates cases where people convicted of murder claim their confessions were coerced, involuntary or false.

title: The Surgeon's Cut
overview: They're philosophers, storytellers and pioneers in their fields. Four surgeons reflect on their lives and professions in this inspiring docuseries.

title: Ugly Delicious
overview: Star chef David Chang leads friends on a mouthwatering, cross-cultural hunt for the world's most satisfying grub. All the flavor. None of the BS.

title: Working: What We Do All Day
overview: For some, it's a paycheck. For others, it's a calling. This docuseries explores the meaning of work for modern Americans in a time of rapid change.

title: Wormwood
overview: In this genre-bending tale, Errol Morris explores the mysterious death of a U.S. scientist entangled in a secret Cold War program known as MK-Ultra.

title: Wrestlers
overview: At a storied professional wrestling organization, new owners and a roster of rising stars strive to make an impact beyond the ring in this docuseries.
